description: Danish Energy Agency (DEA) and Energinet.dk Technology Data is a data resource listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Technology assumptions > Danish Energy Agency (DEA) and Energinet.dk Technology Data", published or maintained by ens.dk (publisher inferred from the link). Last updated 2018. 300 pages of detailed analysis. Includes generation, heating, sector-coupling, storage, grid and CCS technologies. Most information is in English. Projections for 2020, 2030 and 2050. Coverage: as stated on the linked page. The openmod wiki page "Technology assumptions" lists it under "Danish Energy Agency (DEA) and Energinet.dk Technology Data". It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the wiki page (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support technology cost and performance assumption inputs to energy-system models. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
